title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Lionel Messi International Retirement: Lionel Messi officially announced his retirement from international football with Argentina, closing an iconic national team career.

2027 AI Infrastructure Compute Gridlock: Elon Musk highlighted that ~15GW of AI compute capacity produced in 2027 cannot be powered on immediately due to power grid, transformer, and liquid-cooling constraints.
Tim Cook Steps Down as Apple CEO: Tim Cook published a farewell message to the Apple community on his final day as CEO, transitioning to a new role at the company.
US Sovereign Debt Strategy Alert: Treasury Secretary Bessent stated the US must grow its way out of debt through GDP expansion, as Fed Chair Kevin Warsh noted a global investment surge.
Barcelona Sign Gabriel Jesus from Arsenal: Fabrizio Romano confirmed Barcelona agreed a €10m transfer package to sign Arsenal forward Gabriel Jesus.

items.title: @elonmusk: 15GW AI Compute Grid Infrastructure Bottleneck for 2027
items.body: Elon Musk reported industry estimates indicating ~15GW of AI compute manufactured in 2027 cannot be powered on in 2027. Scaling requires solving physical infrastructure beyond power generation, including high-voltage transformers, liquid-cooling loops, massive chillers, and complex networking.

items.title: @tim_cook: Tim Cook Shares Farewell on Final Day as Apple CEO
items.body: Tim Cook published a message expressing gratitude to the global Apple community on his final day as CEO before transitioning his title, reflecting on Apple's ongoing mission and upcoming chapter.

items.title: @openclaw: OpenClaw 2.0 Official Release
items.body: OpenClaw launched version 2.0 of its open-source multi-agent framework, featuring updated agent orchestration, local tool routing, and performance enhancements.

items.title: @esandurrani: Honen Partners with NVIDIA for Enterprise AI Learning
items.body: Esan announced Honen, an AI platform created with NVIDIA support that automatically turns company codebases and docs into interactive, self-improving courses for 250,000 enterprise learners.

items.title: @lennysan: Lenny's Newsletter Partners with SpaceXAI / Grok Bot
items.body: Lenny Rachitsky announced an integration partnership with SpaceXAI and Grok Bot, extending AI assistant tools to newsletter subscribers and developer workflows.

items.title: @thsottiaux: OpenAI Codex Team Celebrates Dashboard Milestone
items.body: OpenAI engineer Tibo (@thsottiaux) shared progress updates on OpenAI Codex capabilities as developers discuss migrating workspace tooling to native model execution environments.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: US Treasury Secretary Bessent on Sovereign Debt
items.body: US Treasury Secretary Bessent emphasized that outgrowing debt through economic expansion and productivity is the primary path forward for US fiscal health.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Highlights Global Investment Surge
items.body: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh noted that global capital allocation is shifting toward infrastructure and productivity, reversing prior savings gluts.

items.title: @APompliano: Gen Z Financial Literacy & Risk Management Trends
items.body: Anthony Pompliano highlighted research demonstrating Gen Z retail investors show disciplined risk aversion and long-term financial planning enabled by accessible digital education.

items.title: @UziCryptoo: Corporate vs Household Tax Code Comparison
items.body: A viral commentary analyzing small business reinvestment write-offs versus personal household expense accounting sparked widespread discussion on tax structure reform.

items.title: @Starlink: Direct Global Connectivity Orders Expand
items.body: Starlink highlighted growing international adoption for high-speed satellite broadband across remote home, enterprise, and mobile deployment scenarios.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: Lionel Messi Retires from Argentina National Team
items.body: Fabrizio Romano reported that Lionel Messi has officially retired from international football with Argentina, ending his historic career for his country.

items.title: @FabrizioRomano: Barcelona Agree €10m Deal for Gabriel Jesus

items.title: @Bayern_PR: Pep Guardiola Backs Harry Kane for Ballon d'Or
items.body: Pep Guardiola publicly endorsed Harry Kane for the Ballon d'Or, praising his 70+ goal campaign, consistency, and overall impact on Bayern Munich's squad.

items.title: @wydcasmir: José Mourinho Analyzes European Football Depth
